declarations.doc:
The sender broadcasts. A faulty sender may crash mid-send and reach
only an arbitrary subset of the processes; a correct sender reaches
everyone. (Note: the domain of the nondet must be a plain set —
`(if (..) powerset(..) else ..).oneOf()` is silently unsatisfiable
under Apalache.)
declarations.name: main::reliable_broadcast::bcast

declarations.doc: On first receipt, relay to everyone, then deliver.
declarations.name: main::reliable_broadcast::relay

declarations.doc:
If some correct process delivers, all correct processes eventually
deliver, given fair relaying (holds).
declarations.name: main::reliable_broadcast::totality

declarations.doc: Without fairness a correct process may never relay (fails).
declarations.name: main::reliable_broadcast::brokenTotalityNoFairness
